capabilities: Group plugins by startup, delayed, and disabled
Search and toggle plugins in place
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or later. Open source under the MIT License. Chinese-first interface; no telemetry, account, or external service; settings and self-measured timings stored locally in the vault. Installable via community plugins, BRAT, or manual copy of main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css.
intentEvidence: How It Differs From Lazy Loader
problem: Obsidian can feel slow to open when many community plugins load at startup, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: How It Differs From Lazy Loader

summary: Plugin manager that delays loading non-essential community plugins to speed up Obsidian startup, with search, grouping, and in-place toggles.
